opendb_id.description: Unique identifier for the document (UUID v4)

weight.description: Product weight in grams for one complete, usable unit of this exact variant. Exclude retail packaging, shipping materials, multipack totals, and load capacity. Leave unset when the product is digital, the weight is unknown, or the source does not clearly identify product weight.

connection_types.description: How audio reaches the headphones. For wired audio, choose the connector at the audio-source end (computer, phone, or console): a USB-C-to-USB-A audio cable is Wired USB-A Audio when USB-A plugs into the source. A charging-only cable is not wired audio; a USB receiver is a wireless connection, regardless of its USB plug. Multiple values indicate alternative audio paths, not guaranteed simultaneous mixing. Plain USB-C and USB-A are legacy values; use the named Wired USB audio values for new claims.

battery_life.description: Manufacturer-stated maximum listening time in hours on one headset or earbud charge, excluding charging-case recharges, talk time, and standby time. Retain ANC, lighting, connection, and test conditions in source evidence; audit legacy values before using them under this definition.

battery_life_with_case.description: Manufacturer-stated total listening hours from the earbuds plus recharges from the charging case included with this exact SKU. Includes the first earbud charge; do not add independently stated numbers, use talk time, or record case-only extra hours.

charging_port.description: Legacy singular charging interface retained during migration. Record verified new charging inputs under Charging Methods; this old value does not prove that other methods are absent.

charging_methods.description: Documented supported external charging inputs for this exact sold configuration. Multiple methods may charge different targets. None is exclusive and requires affirmative evidence; leave the field empty when evidence is missing. Compatibility with a charger does not mean it is included.

items.description: One manufacturer-documented external charging method for this exact sold configuration.

method.description: Verified supported external charging input for the exact sold headset, included case, or removable battery. For wired inputs, name the connector on the charged item, not the plug at the power source. None needs affirmative evidence.

target.description: Which item receives power from this external charging method: the headset, its included charging case, or a removable battery. Leave empty only when method is None.

system_name.description: Exact manufacturer-named system for Proprietary Charging Interface, such as a magnetic cable or dock. Do not enter a system name for standard USB, Lightning, Qi, Qi2, MagSafe Charger, or Apple Watch Charger.

wireless_range.description: One manufacturer-advertised wireless audio range in metres for a documented path. Convert feet only from a known source; retain the path and line-of-sight/test conditions in evidence. Existing values have ambiguous units and require audit before display as metres or use in filters.

has_microphone.description: Whether the headphones include a microphone

lighting.description: Lighting capabilities for this product. Use RGB for non-addressable RGB, ARGB for addressable RGB, Multicolor for non-RGB multi-color lighting, Fixed for a single fixed lighting color, None when the product has no lighting, Display for configurable displays, and Fixed Color Display for displays limited to fixed colors such as black and white.

general_product_information.description: General product information and retailer SKUs

last_manually_spec_verified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the part specs were last manually verified by a human

retailer_listings.description: Canonical retailer product listings used for pricing

identifiers.description: Current versioned product identity snapshot used for retailer and pricing matching
